item.title: EmDash – a spiritual successor to WordPress that solves plugin security
item.description:

item.title: The Document Foundation ejects its core developers
item.description:
📝 As well as those who created and shaped TDF initially this also impacts over thirty Collabora staff members, who have contributed faithfully to LibreOffice for many years. This last apparently with no clear technical plan beyond “to start a discussion”. Outside of the TDF ‘strategy’ bubble – I would also like to acknowledge all the good and decent TDF staff with real experience of FLOSS projects that we have collaborated with around the code for many years very happily to do amazing things: we respect your service, competence and commitment.
🔗 Read more: https://www.collaboraonline.com/blog/tdf-ejects-its-core-developers/
